title: Valneva Reports Sustained 94% Seroresponse Five Years After a Single Dose of Chikungunya Vaccine IXCHIQ®
summary: 94% of participants maintained seroresponse five years after a single vaccination Comparable antibody persistence observed in older (65+) and younger adults Data further reinforce IXCHIQ®‘s differentiated profile with durable antibody persistence against an unpredictable outbreak disease Lyon (France), November 10, 2026 – Valneva SE (Nasdaq: VALN; Euronext Paris: VLA), a specialty vaccine company, today reported […]
body_markdown:
- *94% of participants maintained seroresponse five years after a single vaccination*
- *Comparable antibody persistence observed in older (65+) and younger adults*
- *Data further reinforce IXCHIQ®‘s differentiated profile with durable antibody persistence against an unpredictable outbreak disease*


** **Lyon (France), November 10, 2026** – Valneva SE (Nasdaq: VALN; Euronext Paris: VLA), a specialty vaccine company, today reported positive five-year antibody persistence data for its single dose chikungunya vaccine IXCHIQ®. The results demonstrate durable antibody persistence across all age groups evaluated and are consistent with previously reported persistence results\[1\] ,\[2\] ,\[3\] ,\[4\] . The results are in line with Valneva’s expectations for this vaccine, further supporting IXCHIQ®‘s differentiated profile and its potential to provide long-term protection following a single vaccination, similarly to other live-attenuated vaccines\[5\] ,\[6\] .
